items.name: BUBT Cube Open 2026
items.information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY3MTkzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f0c7b03573c8d2890a99a16e43591722ae9b2491/zndcfgsxfgj.png)



1. You'll have to be present at the competition area at least 10 minutes before the start of your event.
2. All the necessary information is given the Tabs, please have a look.
3. Join [CubistBD](https://www.facebook.com/groups/cubingbangladesh/) to get updates.
4. Follow [Sppedcubing Bangladesh] (https://www.facebook.com/SpeedcubingBD) to know about comps in Bangladesh.
5.  You'll need to show your entry pass in the gate in order to get in.
